class.name: KilnGIWorld
class.brief_description: Native Kiln diffuse and glossy indirect illumination with hardware tracing and software fallback.
class.description: Supplies original rigid MeshInstance3D geometry and scene lights to native Surfel GI. No simplified or imported GI proxy meshes are created. Set kiln_dynamic metadata on moving geometry and kiln_exclude on auxiliary geometry. Mesh, transform, texture and material edits are detected automatically. Both ray-query and software BVH backends use the original mesh triangles. Ray hits sample opaque material albedo at UV1 coordinates from 512x512 texture pages; emission textures use their linear average. GGX reflection rays use the diffuse surfel cache, emission, direct light and sky. Project settings rendering/kiln/surfel_specular and rendering/kiln/specular_rays control indirect specular. Primary surfaces retain the original raster material. Skinned and blend-shape ray geometry and arbitrary ray-hit shaders are not yet supported. Low-level GPU-only geometry changes require rebuild().

method.name: set_capture_roots
method.description: Limits ray geometry to these node subtrees. Empty uses the parent subtree. Duplicate and overlapping roots are captured once; traversal does not cross nested viewports. Paths are relative to this node or absolute. Mesh data remains cached across root changes. Use kiln_dynamic and kiln_exclude metadata to control participating geometry.

method.name: set_ao_quality
method.description: Sets independent XeGTAO quality from 0 (disabled) to 3 (high).

method.name: set_sky_parameters
method.description: Sets solar halo strength, saturation, linear cloud color and cloud coverage for the shared procedural sky model. Changes invalidate lighting history.

method.name: set_query_backend
method.description: Selects 0 (automatic hardware ray query with software fallback, default), 1 (force compute software BVH), or 2 (prefer hardware, with fallback on unsupported devices). Both backends use the same original scene triangles, materials and GI integration. Changing this setting resets lighting history.

method.name: set_quality
method.description: Sets ray quality 1-8, corresponding to 4-32 rays per updated surfel, and the 16-1024 sample convergence budget. Lighting changes use at least 16 rays per updated surfel. Quality changes reset surfel history.

method.name: validate_bvh
method.description: Compares packed-BVH nearest intersections against brute-force triangles using deterministic rays. Diagnostic only; expensive on large worlds.

method.name: get_statistics
method.description: Returns geometry/light versions, uploaded light counts, overflow diagnostics and optional frame profile data. Unavailable GPU times are null.

method.name: rebuild
method.description: Rebuilds static and dynamic geometry and clears mesh-array caches.

method.name: request_capture
method.description: Requests raw diagnostic texture readback to a directory. Synchronous GPU readbacks must not be used during benchmark measurements.

method.name: reset_history
method.description: Rejects temporal and world-cache history without rebuilding geometry.

method.name: set_ao_enabled
method.description: Controls XeGTAO independently of indirect light tracing.

method.name: set_lighting
method.description: Supplies the direction toward the sun, linear color, energies and normalized time of day.

method.name: set_profiling
method.description: Enables engine frame timestamp collection. GPU availability depends on the active device driver.

method.name: set_sky
method.description: Selects shared procedural sky radiance or the original reference sky model using linear horizon and zenith colors.

members.member: Environment associated with this illumination world.
